turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi! How are you doing these days?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My daughter wants to play online with her friends. Moshi, she's ten and I'm nervous about strangers talking to her.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's a very reasonable worry. Most consoles have parental controls that let you limit chat to friends you approve.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay Genesis, who's winning the darts?

turns.speaker: other
turns.text: The guy with the moustache, easily.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My partner wants a ceiling fan in the bedroom and I'm the handy one apparently.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Ha, congratulations. Is there already a light fitting up there you'd replace, or would it need new wiring?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, quick break, I need to talk to my roommate. I'll tell you when I'm done.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Mum, did you put cinnamon in the stew last time, or was it cloves?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Cinnamon, love. Just one stick, and you fish it out before serving.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: One stick for the whole pot?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: For the whole pot. Any more and it tastes like a candle.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay. And the carrots go in at the start?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Halfway through, otherwise they turn to mush.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I'm done. Talk to me, Moshi.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure thing. That ceiling fan. Replacing the light, or running new wires?
